title: Code checks — EN 1993 (steel) + EN 1995 (timber)
emptyHint: Click "Run checks" — the model is solved first if needed, then steel and timber are checked together in one run.
noCheckable: No checkable members: no steel profiles (HEA/HEB/IPE/…) and no timber grades (C24, GL28h, …) in the model.
solverFailed: Solving failed — check the model (supports, loads).
timberFiltered: {{count}} timber result(s) not included in the PDF — the PDF report currently covers steel (EN 1993) only.
runFirst: Run the code checks first (Check tab) before generating a PDF.

cfg.bucklingHint: Empty = system length (follows the member length when geometry changes).
cfg.bracingHint: Fractions of the member length (0–1), separated by commas or spaces — e.g. "0.5" or "0.25 0.5 0.75". Empty = no restraints.
cfg.deflCustomTimberHint: For timber, L/n applies to both w_fin and w_add.
cfg.preCamberHint: Pre-camber in mm, same sign convention as the deflection (negative = down).
cfg.timberHint: Determines k_mod and k_def in the EN 1995 checks.
cfg.staleResultHint: The shown result is from an earlier run with a different material type — run the checks again.
